morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式，与词根连写，不引起词首音变。依据 DBP 的 lamun III 及其 dilamun 实例，纠正资料包误标的独立词根分析。

word_family.gloss: 此处为覆盖、淹没义的词根

senses.en_definition: To be covered or engulfed by water or waves.
senses.ms_definition: Diliputi atau ditenggelami air atau ombak.
senses.nuances: 属于 DBP 标注 Mn（米南加保语来源）的 lamun III 的被动式，常见于文学性描写。[DBP：lamun III](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lamun)

senses.zh_definition: 被爱情、悲伤等强烈情绪笼罩或占据。
senses.en_definition: To be enveloped or overwhelmed by a strong emotion.
senses.ms_definition: Diselubungi atau dikuasai perasaan yang kuat.
senses.nuances: 比喻性被动用法；dilamun cinta 指沉浸爱河。不要简单解释为“被白日梦”，也不要与表示发呆的 melamun 混为一谈。[DBP：lamun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lamun)

collocations.en: to be swept up in love

senses.en_definition: Regionally, to be heaped up without orderly arrangement.
senses.nuances: 由 lamun III 的“杂乱堆放”义构成的规则被动式；不是现代常用搭配。下列为释义性组合，不标作高频搭配。[DBP：lamun III](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lamun)

dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam wawancara itu, beliau mengakui bahawa dirinya masih dilamun dukacita setelah kehilangan sahabat karibnya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他在访谈中坦言，失去挚友后，自己仍深陷悲痛。
dual_scenarios.en: In the interview, he acknowledged that he was still overwhelmed by grief after losing his close friend.

etymology.historical_story: DBP records the relevant lamun entry with a Minangkabau label. Its meanings connect physical covering with emotional experience: water can engulf something, while sorrow can envelop a person. The passive prefix di- makes the affected person or object central. This offers a memorable image for dilamun cinta: love experienced as something that surrounds and overtakes someone.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di- 表示“被”：先想象被浪吞没的 dilamun ombak，再换成被爱情包围的 dilamun cinta。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: dilamun cinta 可用于熟人间轻松打趣；不宜在正式会议中拿同事的感情状态开玩笑。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 描述丧亲或悲伤时语气应庄重。报道实际水灾或海难时，ditenggelami、dihanyutkan 等词应按事实选用；dilamun 本身不必然表示死亡。
